answer.thought: The conversation with Mrs. Kapoor left a residue of shame that a walk might help dissipate, but the body insists on its own logic after five hours of hunger. I shall take a cob of corn from the stall here; it is a crude nourishment, but the spirit must be housed in a body that does not collapse on the verandah. I will move toward Khan Market to stretch my legs and perhaps find a shop open to buy a bottle of water, for the dry air is becoming a problem.
